results.description:
Secrets ignite passion, seduction blurs the lines of trust, and surrender becomes the ultimate sacrifice in this set of swoon-worthy romances. Dive in and meet your new favorite book boyfriend today!

Twisted Devil 

One moment, everything was perfect. The next, she vanished without a trace. There are no clues. No witnesses. And each minute that passes narrows the window of opportunity to bring her back to me safely. The clock is ticking, and I don't have a single second to lose…

Friendly Fire 

I'm in love with my best friend… and she can never know. But when a threat from her past resurfaces and danger closes in, I'll do whatever it takes to keep Claire safe—no matter the cost.

Unrequited Love

Eight years ago the love of my life slipped through my fingers. When she shows up in the middle of the night, battered and bruised, I vow to do everything in my power to protect her and win her heart again. There's just one problem… She has no memory of me.
